teaser: 57 checks taken apart into the 8 behaviours they protect, and where each one is actually kept.
core_idea: Every test checks for a behaviour: walking each of the site's 57 checks up a graph of what it checks, why it exists, the behaviour it protects, where it runs and what keeps it yields eight behaviour policies, shows two with no check in CI and only one check out of the agent's reach, and points to running every repository check in CI and protecting the checks so settings become boundaries.
